cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Orders from the Shadows
cards.instruction: Hide that you set the problem in motion while quietly directing how everyone responds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I ticked all the wedding bookings like you did. Now the couples have cancellation emails; please call them while I sort the screen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ticked them to export the list. You pressed cancel. The log has your initials.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, the selected list. Keep that log here; give the couples replacement dates while I check it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can restore everything, but the email will name you as the person who cancelled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Restore the dates one at a time instead. I'll stay and read them out; no need for the bulk email.

reason: Make copied selection procedure cause the cancellations and preserve B efficient but identifying restoration offer.
